units.source_text: 这名少女名字叫做宋金花，刚满15岁，是个见不得人的妓女，为了生计，不得不夜夜在房里接客。

en.t: This young girl was named Song Jinhua. She had just turned fifteen, and she was a hidden prostitute who had no choice but to receive clients in her room every night in order to make a living.

units.source_text: 秦淮河妓女诸多，像金花这等姿色的也不在少数。

en.t: There were many prostitutes along the Qinhuai River, and quite a few of them were as pretty as Jinhua.

units.source_text: 但是，像金花这种性格温顺的少女，却不一定能找出来第二个。

en.t: But it was not at all certain that one could find another girl as gentle in temperament as Jinhua.

units.source_text: 她和同辈的那些妓女大不相同，不说瞎话也不任性而行，每个夜晚她都能面带笑容，陪来小屋的客人们开心的嬉闹。

en.t: She was very different from the other prostitutes of her age. She did not lie or act willfully, and every night she could smile as she played merrily with the clients who came to her little room.

units.source_text: 有时候，客人会多给一点钱，她就会开心的给年迈却好酒的父亲多来一杯。

en.t: Sometimes a client would give her a little extra money, and she would happily buy one more cup of wine for her aging father, who loved to drink.
